notes.title: Update 0.8: Creative Showcase 2
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing update 0.8: Creative Showcase 2[/h1]

[h2]Touch grass on the islets, editable artifact descriptions, and discover new artifacts (food artifacts, finally) in the update 0.8: Creative Showcase 2![/h2]

[b]---[/b]
[i][b]Review Reminder:[/b][/i] If you purchased Infinity Islets, please leave a review. It helps a lot!
[b]---[/b]

Touch grass on the islets! Islets may now contain grass. Each islet will feature a different variation of grass color, making them more vibrant and lively.

Editable artifact descriptions. Learn more about each artifact or create your own story!

Food artifacts were finally added. Don't forget to feed your lovely animals in the museum! Artifacts that were added: more connecting metal platforms, an ancient woman statue, a soccer ball, an udon, a pizza, and a realistic wolf! I hope you enjoy it, and I'm excited to see what you'll create! As always, please report any bugs you encounter, and your feedback is much appreciated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44501889/fda02744c63e091f5df962572d56fa63f89d345e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44501889/25c7cc613beb932e83f0e93ac5a0ecd9fa0065b0.png[/img]

🎮✨🐧

[h3]Full update notes:[/h3]

[b]Gameplay:[/b] Editable artifact descriptions.

[b]Visuals:[/b] Islets may now contain grass. Each islet will feature a different variation of grass color, making them more vibrant and lively.

[b]Artifacts:[/b] 2 additional connecting metal platforms, an ancient woman statue, a soccer ball, udon, pizza, and a realistic wolf.

Various other small fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.7: Creative Showcase
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing update 0.7: Creative Showcase[/h1]

[h2]Duplicate, resize, spin, snap, and sell artifacts. A new shop item that lets you see through the sands! Discover new artifacts and enjoy numerous improvements in the update 0.7: Creative Showcase![/h2]

[b]---[/b]
[i][b]Review Reminder:[/b][/i] If you purchased Infinity Islets, please leave a review. It helps a lot!
[b]---[/b]

[i]Suspicious Penguin is delighted to finally present update 0.7: Creative Showcase! I've worked hard on new features, many of which were highly requested by players. Along the way, I've faced numerous challenges, including reworking the saving system and introducing the artifact impostor performance system, which now allows you to store thousands of artifacts in your museum. I hope you enjoy it, and I'm excited to see what you'll create! As always, please report any bugs you encounter, and your feedback is much appreciated. 

Take a look at the trailer showcasing the new features [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eTkAdI3uieg]here[/url]

For long-term performance improvements, all collected artifacts had to be wiped out. I apologize for the inconvenience caused. The amount of Shards and Inferno Orbs collected will remain unchanged. 

Support the development of Infinity Islets and receive the new fashionable Nightshade Supporter Robe!: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475820/Infinity_Islets__Nightshade_Supporter_Upgrade/]Nightshade Supporter Upgrade[/url][/i]

🎮✨🐧

[h3]Full update notes:[/h3]

[b]Building Mode:[/b] Duplicate, resize, spin, snap, and sell artifacts! Ignite your creative spark!

Improved button prompts for building mode controls.

[b]Gameplay:[/b] After mentioning to the Mysterious Merchant that it would make things so much easier if I could see through the sands, they brew a potion and hand it over. They call it the Sandsight Potion. It should grant the user a permanent ability to glance through the sands with enough concentration, revealing artifact locations and more. Use at your own risk. The merchant mentioned that it's the first time they have ever made this potion.

Inferno orb price reduced and power increased.

Mining and chain indicators were added to better understand the game mechanics.

New menu setting to control vertex snapping rotation.

[b]Performance:[/b] Reworked the saving system to ensure loading times are as fast as possible.

Introduced the artifact impostor performance system, which now allows you to store hundreds, if not thousands, of artifacts in your museum.

[b]Artifacts:[/b] 16 new special cube-type artifacts designed specifically for building.

23 new pop, emotional and epic music tracks for music artifacts have been added.

Dog, sombrero, skateboard, basketball, Jesus, and a new radio were added.

You’re now much less likely to lose an artifact.

Cats were improved.

[b]Visuals:[/b] Radiant Global Illumination has been reintroduced to improve visuals.

Islet realms are now more colorful and interesting. A new islet texture added.

Support the development of Infinity Islets and receive the new fashionable Nightshade Supporter Robe!: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475820/Infinity_Islets__Nightshade_Supporter_Upgrade/]Nightshade Supporter Upgrade[/url]

Artifacts are more colorful now.

New museum skybox.

[b]Controls:[/b] Controls were reset to accommodate the new actions added.

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b] Achievement progress indicator added.

The Hooded Wanderer now respawns if they accidentally fall under the museum floor.

Islet walls have been moved. Islets feel less constrained now.

Various other small fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6: Mysterious Merchant
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing update 0.6: Mysterious Merchant[/h1]

[h2]Mine crystals for shards, meet the enigmatic merchant, and purchase Inferno Orbs that carve out hollows in the sand and launch you into the air if they explode nearby![/h2]

[b]---[/b]
[i][b]Review Reminder:[/b][/i] If you purchased Infinity Islets, please leave a review. It helps a lot!

[i]In celebration of the GameOn Gaming Expo in Vilnius, Suspicious Penguin is delighted to offer a special discount on Infinity Islets![/i]🎮✨

[h3]Full update notes:[/h3]

[b]Artifact Preservation:[/b] You’re now much less likely to lose an artifact while building.

[b]Controller Sensitivity: [/b]Controllers are now less sensitive for better control.

[b]Portal Placement:[/b] The portal now opens closer to the player, making it easier to use in narrow spaces while digging.

[b]Artifact Concealment:[/b] It’s now more difficult to peek through walls to see what kind of artifact is hiding underneath the sands.

[b]Improved Aiming:[/b] A crosshair has been added to make aiming easier.

[b]Button Prompts:[/b] Button prompt text is now smaller, obstructing less of the game view.

[b]New Achievement:[/b] A new achievement called Affluent Interdimensional Archeologist has been added.

[b]Cancel Aim Action:[/b] A new input action to cancel aim has been added. Useful when you don’t want to throw the chain or orbs after entering aim mode. [u][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/u] If you’ve played the game before this update, you’ll need to manually assign a button to this action in the control settings. The right mouse button or left trigger is recommended.

[b]New Music Tracks:[/b] 23 new music tracks for music artifacts have been added

[b]New Artifacts:[/b] New artifacts with Low Poly Stone Age and Sci-Fi themes have been added.

[b]Islet Fog Light:[/b] The islet fog light now has a sound effect, making it easier to find.

[b]Improved Jumping:[/b] Jumping is now easier and smoother.

[b]Sand Particles:[/b] Sand particles now appear while digging for better immersion.

[b]Building Mode improvement:[/b] The character no longer obstructs the view while in building mode and an artifact is attached.

[b]Graphics Enhancement:[/b] The game’s graphics have been slightly improved with a sharpen effect.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.2
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there! Thank you for playing Infinity Islets![/h3]

[h3]This patch brings fixes, improvements, and changes that make the game more enjoyable.[/h3]



[h1]What's changed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The mysterious light that transports you to another islet now moves, making it easier and more engaging to find.
[*]Building is much easier now. When you place an artifact in building mode, it remains immovable, allowing for the construction of more complex structures. Additionally, players don’t accidentally push or knock over their creations.
[*]An indicator to tell whether the player is in building mode or not.
[*]Players don't have to hold the tool button to use it anymore. One click is enough.
[*]Some artifacts have been missing from the game. You can find them now. This includes low-poly cats.
[*]Two new sand textures to bring more variety to the islets.
[*]Slightly improved button prompts and they're now more visible than before.
[*]Other small fixes and improvements.
[/list]
